listing.name: Tomb Raider I-III / TRX (LostArtefacts)
listing.summary: Set up Tomb Raider I–III with the upstream TRX Windows installer and your original game files.

steps.title: Run the upstream Windows installer
steps.instruction: Open the download folder and run the Windows Installer EXE yourself. Choose a separate TRX folder and the game packs you want.

steps.title: Select your original game files
steps.instruction: Use the installer’s supported Steam, GOG or disc locations for the corresponding Tomb Raider games. Let it arrange the required files; the portable ZIP needs manual game-specific placement instead.

steps.title: Choose the installed player
steps.instruction: Finish Portcove setup with the installed TRX.exe and its folder. Keep game files, cfg, saves, screenshots and any custom profile folders backed up when applying upstream updates.

warnings: The three games keep their corresponding original-data requirements. Installing the engine does not supply ownership of commercial game data.
